title: A tutorial on the modeling of the heterogenous captured CO2 electroreduction reaction and first principles electrochemical modeling
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS01210K, Tutorial Review
Robert Michael Kowalski, Dongfang Cheng, Philippe Sautet
We review the modelling and mechanism of the electroreduction of captured CO2 which bypasses the energetically unfavorable release of CO2 from the capture agent by directly reducing CO2 in its captured form.
